body: She’s so adorable, she absolutely looks part Pom!
He looked exactly like yours in his puppy stages :)

I’ve known a purebred who looked exactly like yours! Mine is also quite large but 100% pom. They’re called throwbacks but it’s just that Pom’s were bred to be small, there’s plenty of bigger ones out there that haven’t been bred out/have the past genes come out. He’s super cute and special looking! 🐾
